name: Zoomly
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Xeonz
description: The lightweight OptiFine zoom alternative for modern Minecraft. Smooth adjustable zoom, customizable controls, multi-loader support, and zero unnecessary bloat.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.1 (17 classes, 20 members). Not run yet.

development.name: Zoomly
development.statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
development.works: Holding C zooms the view in, and the mouse wheel while zooming changes how far.
development.note: Not yet: the wheel also moves the hotbar while zooming, as Kiln can't stop Horizon's own wheel yet; the zoom works fully without it. Its settings screen doesn't open under Kiln yet.
